label: Guide me: Intake & map

params.name: lede
params.default: Bring the client's statements and final accounts into {product} and give every row its SF Ref - most are suggested for you.
params.label: lede

default.title: Pick the client
default.say: Choose the client and year; their statements are listed here.

default.title: Upload
default.say: Excel or CSV. The same file again offers to replace it - refs stay on unchanged rows and the old version is kept.

default.title: Map rows
default.say: Rows come grouped under the statement's own headings. Each heading adds up the way the statement means it - Less: rows taken off - and is checked against the statement's own total.

default.title: Suggested refs
default.say: Most rows are already suggested: income heads, TDS, 3CD clauses - and under a Balance Sheet or P&L heading, items like ITR3 BS debtors or ITR3 PL salaries. Accept them all, then fix the few left.

default.title: Find a row
default.say: A long statement? Search by row number, words, heading, SF Ref or amount - any part, any order.

default.title: Save
default.say: Every change is saved; the stage moves on once every row has a valid ref.

default.title: History
default.say: Every change, field by field - was, now, when and who - and every earlier version of a statement, ready to download.

description_nl: 2026-10-04: the Intake & map walk, up to date with the screen; tours/sf-intake.json is made from it.
